_how: One screen = one spoken line = one point. Give every screen: a headline, a Tamil line, a picture, ONE motion graphic that shows what the line says (rules/motion.md), the spoken Tamil line (voice_line) and the same line in Tanglish (caption). Screen lengths come from the recorded voice; do not set dur on voiced screens.
credit: Film · Production house, or NEWS: date / sources

music.mood: from the niche mood map; or track: exact file name

screens.headline: 7 words or fewer. *stars* make a word gold.
screens.caption: Tanglish subtitle, about 6 words
screens.voice_line: பேசப்படும் தமிழ் வரி. இதுவே தமிழ் சப்டைட்டில்.

screens.headline: same headline keeps the text still

caption.text: 4 lines: hook reworded / value with search words / one easy question / the call

punch.shows: one or two big words: the hook question, one key word

points.shows: numbered boxes; build:true the first time, then active:N lights the one being discussed

cast.shows: name chips: who is in it

timer.shows: a clock draining, time [from,to] 0-1; rise [from,to] adds a climbing bar

tension.shows: a line climbing; peaks name moments

switch.shows: place tabs and a cut streak from → to; pending labels the place left hanging

goal.shows: a person, a goal, barriers dropping between them

count.shows: a number counting up; prefix, suffix, label

timeline.shows: dated stops; the marker travels to stop number at

status.shows: fact rows: state yes / wait / no

versus.shows: two craft choices and a balance; tilt -1 left, 1 right

quote.shows: a quoted line and who said it

callout.shows: a ring on a detail inside the clip; may be added to one other graphic

cta.shows: the mascot and the send pill: the last screen
